Lana LEGUÍA (Independent — Libertarian Party), listed for Member of the House of Representatives (New Jersey's 7th Congressional District) in the Morris County Clerk's filed-candidate document read 2026-08-31, is not on the clerk's revision 2026-general-election-candidates-9012026.pdf read 2026-09-02. The revision does not say why.

The Morris County Clerk’s complete official November 3, 2026 general-election sample ballots contain no statewide public question. All 46 published ballot styles were checked; Boonton Township’s and Mount Olive’s school bonds and Pequannock’s open-space referendum are local questions.
